faq.q: What is the origin of Abraar?
faq.a: Abraar is associated with Arabic. Abrār, plural of بَرّ ('righteous, pious'). The source record's form أبرار is correct; the gloss 'Fearer of Allah' is an extension.
Yes — the underlying form أبرار is Arabic.
Abraar can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
